title: SegSEM: Enabling and Enhancing SAM2 for SEM Contour Extraction
summary: Extracting high-fidelity 2D contours from Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) images is critical for calibrating Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) models. While foundation models like Segment Anything 2 (SAM2) are promising, adapting them to specialized domains with scarce annotated data is a major challenge. This paper presents a case study on adapting SAM2 for SEM contour extraction in a few-shot setting. We propose SegSEM, a framework built on two principles: a data-efficient fine-tuning strategy that adapts by selectively training only the model's encoders, and a robust hybrid architecture integrating a traditional algorithm as a confidence-aware fallback. Using a small dataset of 60 production images, our experiments demonstrate this methodology's viability. The primary contribution is a methodology for leveraging foundation models in data-constrained industrial applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SegSEM框架，通过选择性训练编码器的数据高效微调策略和集成传统算法作为置信度后备的混合架构，在少量标注数据下适配SAM2模型用于SEM图像轮廓提取。
AI.motivation: 从扫描电子显微镜（SEM）图像中提取高保真2D轮廓对于校准光学邻近校正（OPC）模型至关重要。虽然基础模型如Segment Anything 2（SAM2）很有前景，但在标注数据稀缺的专业领域适配这些模型是一个重大挑战。
AI.method: 提出SegSEM框架，基于两个原则：1）数据高效的微调策略，仅选择性训练模型的编码器；2）鲁棒的混合架构，集成传统算法作为置信度感知的后备机制。使用60张生产图像的小数据集进行实验。
AI.result: 实验证明该方法在少量数据设置下的可行性，展示了在数据受限的工业应用中利用基础模型的有效方法。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出了一种在数据受限的工业应用中利用基础模型的方法论，为专业领域的小样本学习提供了可行的解决方案。

title: FAST-Prefill: FPGA Accelerated Sparse Attention for Long Context LLM Prefill
summary:
In long-context large language model (LLM) inference, the prefill stage dominates computation due to self-attention over the complete input context. Sparse attention significantly reduces self-attention computation by limiting each token's interactions to a subset of tokens. The attention sparsity pattern varies across input prompts, and within a prompt, each attention head can follow a distinct pattern. This makes attention sparsity dynamic. The requirement of generating the sparsity pattern, combined with limited data reuse in attention, shifts the prefill compute to being memory-bound. This, in addition to the huge energy requirements for long-context inference on GPU, motivates FPGAs as good candidates for accelerating dynamic long-context inference.
  To tackle these challenges, we propose FAST-Prefill, the first FPGA accelerator for long-context prefill-stage inference with dynamic sparse attention. To efficiently generate sparse indices, we propose a \textit{fused pipeline unit with a memory-aware execution order} to reduce large tensors and irregular memory accesses. To reduce off-chip memory traffic for accessing the KV cache, we utilize the memory hierarchy to design a \textit{liveness-driven, dual-tier cache}. For high-throughput matrix multiplication, we design a \textit{hybrid Matrix Processing Unit (MPU)} with DSPs and bit-plane decomposition using LUTs. We implement FAST-Prefill on Alveo U280 and evaluate it on the Llama and Qwen models (batch size = 1) for context lengths ranging from 4K to 128K tokens. We demonstrate an average speedup of up to 2.5$\times$ in TTFT and 4.5$\times$ improvement in energy efficiency over GPU implementation on Nvidia A5000 GPU.

AI.tldr: FAST-Prefill：首个用于长上下文预填充阶段推理的FPGA加速器，采用动态稀疏注意力，相比GPU在TTFT上实现2.5倍加速，能效提升4.5倍
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM推理中，预填充阶段由于需要对完整输入上下文进行自注意力计算而主导计算开销。稀疏注意力通过限制token交互子集来减少计算，但注意力稀疏模式随输入提示变化且每个注意力头可遵循不同模式，使得注意力稀疏性动态变化。生成稀疏模式的需求加上注意力计算中有限的数据重用，使预填充计算变为内存受限。此外，GPU上进行长上下文推理的巨大能耗需求促使FPGA成为加速动态长上下文推理的良好候选方案。
AI.method: 提出FAST-Prefill FPGA加速器，采用三种关键技术：1）融合流水线单元与内存感知执行顺序，减少大张量和不规则内存访问以高效生成稀疏索引；2）利用内存层次设计活跃性驱动的双级缓存，减少访问KV缓存的片外内存流量；3）设计混合矩阵处理单元（MPU），结合DSP和基于LUT的位平面分解实现高吞吐量矩阵乘法。
AI.result: 在Alveo U280上实现FAST-Prefill，在Llama和Qwen模型（批大小=1）上评估，上下文长度范围从4K到128K token。相比Nvidia A5000 GPU实现，在TTFT上平均加速达2.5倍，能效提升4.5倍。
AI.conclusion: FAST-Prefill成功证明了FPGA在加速长上下文LLM预填充阶段推理方面的潜力，通过动态稀疏注意力和专门的内存优化技术，在性能和能效方面显著优于GPU实现。

title: TOM: A Ternary Read-only Memory Accelerator for LLM-powered Edge Intelligence
summary: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) for real-time intelligence on edge devices is rapidly growing. However, conventional hardware architectures face a fundamental memory wall challenge, where limited on-device memory capacity and bandwidth severely constrain the size of deployable models and their inference speed, while also limiting on-device adaptation. To address this challenge, we propose TOM, a hybrid ROM-SRAM accelerator co-designed with ternary quantization, which balances extreme density with on-device tunability. TOM exploits the synergy between ternary quantization and ROM to achieve extreme memory density and bandwidth, while preserving flexibility through a hybrid ROM-SRAM architecture designed for QLoRA-based tunability. Specifically, we introduce: (1) a sparsity-aware ROM architecture that synthesizes ternary weights as standard-cell logic, eliminating area overhead from zero-valued bits; (2) a distributed processing architecture that co-locates high-density ROM banks with flexible SRAM-based QLoRA adapters and compute units; and (3) a workload-aware dynamic power gating scheme that exploits the logic-based nature of ROM to power down inactive banks, minimizing dynamic energy consumption. TOM achieves an inference throughput of 3,306 TPS using BitNet-2B model, demonstrating its effectiveness in delivering real-time, energy-efficient edge intelligence.

AI.tldr: TOM是一种混合ROM-SRAM加速器，通过三元量化与ROM-SRAM协同设计，解决边缘设备部署大语言模型时的内存墙问题，实现高密度存储和实时推理。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备部署大语言模型面临内存墙挑战，传统硬件架构受到片上内存容量和带宽限制，制约了模型规模和推理速度，同时限制了设备端自适应能力。
AI.method: 提出TOM混合ROM-SRAM加速器，结合三元量化技术，包括：(1) 稀疏感知ROM架构，将三元权重合成为标准单元逻辑，消除零值比特面积开销；(2) 分布式处理架构，将高密度ROM存储与基于SRAM的QLoRA适配器和计算单元协同布局；(3) 工作负载感知动态功耗门控方案，利用基于逻辑的ROM特性关闭非活跃存储块，最小化动态能耗。
AI.result: TOM在BitNet-2B模型上实现了3,306 TPS的推理吞吐量，证明了其在提供实时、高能效边缘智能方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TOM通过ROM-SRAM混合架构与三元量化协同设计，成功解决了边缘设备部署LLM的内存墙问题，在保持设备端自适应能力的同时实现了高密度存储和高效推理。

title: LUTstructions: Self-loading FPGA-based Reconfigurable Instructions
summary: General-purpose processors feature a limited number of instructions based on an instruction set. They can be numerous, such as with vector extensions that include hundreds or thousands of instructions, but this comes at a cost; they are often unable to express arbitrary tasks efficiently. This paper explores the concept of having reconfigurable instructions by incorporating reconfigurable areas in a softcore. It follows a relatively-recently proposed computer architecture concept for seamlessly loading instruction implementation-carrying bitstreams from main memory. The resulting softcore is entirely evaluated on an FPGA, essentially having an FPGA-on-an-FPGA for the instruction implementations, with no notable operating frequency overhead. This is achieved with a custom FPGA architecture called LUTstruction, which is tailored towards low-latency for custom instructions and wide reconfiguration, as well as a soft implementation for the purposes of architectural exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在软核处理器中集成可重构指令的概念，通过从主内存加载指令实现位流，实现FPGA上的FPGA架构，无显著频率开销
AI.motivation: 通用处理器指令集有限，虽然可以通过向量扩展等方式增加指令数量，但成本较高且无法高效表达任意任务
AI.method: 采用LUTstruction定制FPGA架构，专为低延迟自定义指令和广泛重构设计，在软核中集成可重构区域，实现无缝加载指令实现位流
AI.result: 实现了完全在FPGA上评估的软核，本质上具有FPGA上的FPGA架构用于指令实现，无显著操作频率开销
AI.conclusion: 通过可重构指令架构，可以在软核处理器中灵活高效地实现自定义指令，为计算机架构探索提供了新的可能性
